official_source_context.InstructScene_README_training_runtime: 1-3 days per semantic graph prior or layout decoder on a single NVIDIA A40 depending on room type

important_non_extrapolation: Batch-4 qualification measurements are not used to assert that batch 128 fits or to predict A100 training duration. Exact batch-128 forward/backward resource preflight is mandatory before optimizer step 1.

checkpoint_budget.retention_policy: retain all 50k checkpoints through reproduction qualification; pruning requires a later content-addressed retention adjudication and may never remove final or interruption/recovery evidence

parallel_execution_policy.reason: Official InstructScene trains layout decoder from ground-truth graphs independently of the semantic graph prior; SGP-12 and SGP-14 are also independent once their common initialization invariant is frozen.
parallel_execution_policy.resource_claim_rule: claim only an otherwise-idle eligible GPU; never preempt another research job

dynamic_hosts_observed_during_planning.231: A100 80GB observed busy at planning time; do not bind
dynamic_hosts_observed_during_planning.232: A100 80GB observed idle at planning time; observation only, not a reservation
dynamic_hosts_observed_during_planning.69: candidate from prior project infrastructure; must be rechecked at launch

failure_policy.reason: Any of these changes modifies the frozen training execution object and requires a separate amendment before optimizer step 1.

scope_cost_control.why_not_multi_seed_now: The standalone paper has a preregistered stop rule at the later developmental P1. Training confirmatory replication seeds before observing whether the mechanism exists would spend substantially more compute without increasing the validity of the go/no-go decision.
scope_cost_control.confirmatory_expansion_if_later_justifie: separate authority and fresh novelty check
